constraints: propertyName is mandatory when collection contains objects (values are read from that property of each object); it must be omitted when collection contains plain values.
Any number of additional (array; propertyName) pairs may be passed to fan the same collection out into multiple arrays in one call.
After execution every filled array has a size equal to the collection length.

overloadMerges.note: Fixed direction of the leading 'array' and repeated trailing group's 'array' member to 'out' since the command fills/sizes them from the collection; params were otherwise correct so kept as a single-source merge.

params.name: array
params.description: Array to receive the elements of the collection; if propertyName passed, array to receive the values of propertyName in the collection

params.name: propertyName
params.description: Object property name whose values to copy in array ("" for all elements); mandatory if collection holds objects

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills one or more arrays with either the raw elements of a values collection, or with a named property's values pulled from each object of an objects collection, optionally fanning out multiple (array; propertyName) pairs in one call.
